L0501

Slice copy inside a loop (lint)

What

Slice copy inside a loop (lint)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for L0501

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0501: tests/ui_lint/slice_in_loop.warn.

Warning [L0501] (slice_copy_in_loop): slicing inside a loop copies every time
  --> tests/ui_lint/slice_in_loop.jet:4:20
    |
  4 |         piece :: xs[i..i]
    |                    ^^^^^^
 Why: each slice makes a fresh copy of the range — that adds up in a loop
 Fix: build indices outside the loop, or collect into one list
